risk_assessment.headline_verdict: CRITICAL FLOOD DISASTER CONFIRMED along River Brahmaputra in Kamrup Metropolitan district.
risk_assessment.chain_of_thought_reasoning:
1. METEOROLOGICAL ANALYSIS: Active cloudburst/extreme rainfall event (22.1 mm/h, 24h cumulative 1453.1 mm) with sharp barometric depression (-0.2 hPa) and squall gusts (101.6 km/h).
2. HYDRAULIC & RIVERINE STAGE: River Brahmaputra has BREACHED the official Danger Level (50.50 m) at 52.076 m (buffer: +1.576 m). Rate of rise is surging at +0.000 m/h.
3. TOPOGRAPHIC RUNOFF BEHAVIOR: Catchment terrain has low permeability (Silty Clay Loam, runoff coefficient 0.78, TWI 12.2), accelerating overland surge directly into drainage networks (choke ratio: 100%).
4. SPACEBORNE OBSERVATION: Clear sky condition (20% cloud); optical NDWI (0.850) and SAR radar (-27.5 dB) corroborate surface water extent.
5. CROSS-DOMAIN SYNTHESIS: Multi-agent consensus weighted score evaluates to 0.950 with 94.8% sensor certainty. Conclusion: CRITICAL FLOOD DISASTER CONFIRMED along River Brahmaputra in Kamrup Metropolitan district.

decision_and_early_warning.public_broadcast_sms: [URGENT ROUTE DIVERSION - RED ALERT] Primary Evacuation Camp (Kamrup Metropolitan Central Flood Relief Camp & High School Ground) is INUNDATED by expanding floodwaters! DO NOT PROCEED TOWARDS LOWLANDS. All evacuees must IMMEDIATELY DIVERT to Alternative High-Ground Safe Haven: Gauhati University (Jalukbari) Elevated Highland Complex (Tier-1 Elevated Highland Academic Citadel, Distance: 7.44 km). Move to high ground immediately!

recommended_tactical_actions.action: Seal off inundated Primary Camp access road. Direct all citizen evacuation convoys along elevated bypass routes to Gauhati University (Jalukbari) Elevated Highland Complex.
Deploy 4 NDRF battalions & SDRF motorized rescue boats to Bharalumukh Sluice Gate Basin & Outfall, Anil Nagar & Nabin Nagar Low-Lying Urban Wards.
Full closure of Brahmaputra outfall sluice gates to prevent backflow into Kamrup Metropolitan municipal storm channels.
Activate all auxiliary heavy dewatering diesel pumps (5000 gpm); shut down inundated electrical transformers.
Enforce traffic diversions across arterial bridges and secure elevated evacuation corridors to district relief shelters.
Establish mobile medical clinics, potable water tankers, and dry ration distribution in designated cyclone/flood shelters.
